narrative.name: Bitcoin
narrative.regimeNote: H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -10.63 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP
narrative.thesis: trend down regime (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -10.63 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP), but price sits 2.35σ from the Day VWAP — chasing here pays no edge. Working limit order at the trend-side band 65923.1-66458.6; the offer is earned when footprint absorption or a strong divergence prints at the zone.

plan.triggerRule: limit fill at the zone + bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap)
plan.invalidation: Day VWAP 0σ lost (regime flip)
vetoes: chase guard: > 2.0σ VWAP extension — wait for the pullback

factors.value: H4 down · D1 down · spread -10.63 ATR

views.method: structural prior (reflection-principle + gambler's ruin + checklist log-odds)

probability.method: reflection-principle first passage + gambler's ruin + checklist log-odds edge

notes: riskReversal25d approximated: call IV at the strike nearest 1.1x spot vs put IV nearest 0.9x spot (book-summary rows carry no deltas)
oiWalls oiUsd = open_interest (BTC/ETH contracts) x underlying_price
gex: gamma computed via Black-Scholes (r=0, q=0) from mark_iv + underlying_price + time-to-expiry
gex: netGexUsd = sum(call OI x gamma) - sum(put OI x gamma); netGexUsdPer1Pct scales it by spot^2 x 1%
gex.gammaFlipPrice: zero-gamma root of the OI-weighted dealer gamma profile over a 0.70x-1.30x spot grid (expiries <= 90d, 503 legs) — above it dealer hedging stabilizes, below it accelerates
